name: Startup School 2026
description: Highly selective in-person event. YC hand-selects promising builders and flies them to SF for 2 days (July 25-26 2026). Strong signal for future YC applicants.
notes: Application asks about things built and coding agent sessions

name: The Eigenprize
eligibility: Anyone who builds discovers or does things. No age interest or location limits.
description: 10-minute application for up to $100k. No strings attached - no equity taken zero expectations. For builders scientists and operators.
notes: Very quick application process by design

name: Comma Zero 2.0
eligibility: College students recent grads (up to 1 year) HS students dropouts or non-college
description: First check program for young founders. Positions itself as founders first believer. Believes AI is the great equalizer for young founders.

name: AI4PH Internship Program
eligibility: Must have legal work authorization in Canada. International students with study permits allowing off-campus work eligible.
description: Part-time (10-15 hrs/week) internship applying AI/ML to public health challenges. Work with 12 host organizations across Canada. Some positions remote.

name: O'Shaughnessy Fellowship
eligibility: Adults worldwide. Seeks self-directed individuals with demonstrated initiative.
compensation_details: $100k fellowship (10 awards) or $10k+ grant (up to 20 awards)
description: One-year program for builders researchers and creatives. No equity taken. Access to network of founders investors mentors. Rolling review - most hear back within 30 days.

name: Founders Inc
eligibility: Builders in emerging tech (AR/VR hardware AI/ML Web3 dev tools consumer). Must show previous project success and traction.
description: Not a traditional accelerator - a long-term home to build. Includes desk space hardware lab gym office hours fundraising support. No decks or pitches - apply then build at lab for 1-2 weeks.
